acquisition method: developed a data-dependent acquisition method that would use elements of the Universal Method
alkylation reagent: some lysine residues would react with acrylamide to create overlapping peptides
alkylation concentration: the lysate was mixed with 30% acrylamide, polymerized, and shredded
cleavage agent: Samples where then digested with either trypsin or elastase.
collision energy: collision-induced dissociation (CID) fragmentation at a collision energy of 35%... increased collision energy (32% instead of 25%)
fractionation method: The individual digests were then prefractionated via high-pH reversed phase chromatography (C18, 30 fractions)
fragmentation method: Low abundant precursors with a charge state of 2 would be fragmented with CID... highly abundant precursors with a charge state of >2 would be fragmented using HCD
instrument: MS data were acquired with an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos instrument
ionization type: using a Dionex Ultimate 3000 nano-UPLC with EASY-Spray column
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: 100 mM DTT and sonicated the lysate
reduction concentration: 100 mM DTT and sonicated the lysate
